items.statement: High-cost borrowings reduced; working capital funding needed due to long government payment cycles
items.quote: So, yes, we have reduced, borrowings a lot, and these were mainly high-cost borrowings.

items.statement: Target debt level around 15% of revenue or below
items.quote: But, we want to be at around 15% or below.

items.statement: H1 FY26 total revenue was approximately INR 15.6 crores versus INR 15 crores in the corresponding period last year.
items.quote: For the half-year ended 30th September 2025, the company reported a total revenue of approximately INR15.6 crores compared to INRIS crores in the coresponding period last year.

items.statement: H1 FY26 EBITDA stood at approximately INR 74 lakhs.
items.quote: Atan operating level, EBITDA stood at approximately INR 74 lakhs for H1 FY *26.

items.statement: H1 FY26 profit after tax was approximately INR 2.1 crores.
items.quote: Profit after tax for the half year was approximately 2.1 crores.

items.statement: FY26 revenue target is flat versus FY25; FY27 revenue target is INR 50-60 crores.
items.quote: The FY '26 would be a majorly a flat number, like what we did in FY 25, right. And we should be we should be closing and targeting to INRSO crores to INRO crores in, in terms of revenue in127.

Bottom line. So obviously, this year, we've already seen the first 6 months have been not that good in terms of achieving the bottom line numbers. But we are very hopeful that to bounce back in the next year, like '27, the bottom line should be somewhere around 20 - 25% PAT margin of 20%, 25%?

items.statement: Dubai campus expected to start in Q4 FY26; Paris campus expected in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: So basically, Dubai we are expecting it to start in the first quarter - no, in the last quarter, sorry, in the last quarter of this year itself and France like Paris one should come up in the first quarter itself because we are very aggressive there as well.

items.statement: Campus capex will be asset-light, primarily rental and operating expenses.
items.quote: It would be majorly asset light model, We will be taking it on rent and all. So not a major kind of a thing in terms of the - it would be majorly an expense from the operating expenses more.
